dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's freezing! It's even colder than I expected.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈfriːzɪŋ! ɪts ˈiːvən ˈkoʊldər ðən aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was fifteen below zero this morning. Even the inside of my nose was cold!
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˌfɪfˈtiːn bɪˈloʊ ˈzɪroʊ ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ˈiːvən ði ˌɪnˈsaɪd əv maɪ ˈnoʊz wʌz ˈkoʊld!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! Welcome to Canada! Are you wearing enough layers?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈwɛlkəm tə ˈkænədə! ər juː ˈwɛrɪŋ ɪˈnʌf ˈleɪərz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three layers, a hat and two pairs of socks. But even that isn't enough sometimes.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈleɪərz, ə ˈhæt ənd ˈtuː ˈpɛrz əv ˈsɑːks. bʌt ˈiːvən ðæt ˈɪzənt ɪˈnʌf ˈsʌmtaɪmz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What about inside? Is the heating good?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˌɪnˈsaɪd? ɪz ðə ˈhiːtɪŋ ˈɡʊd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's very warm inside. Even the buses have heating.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈvɛri ˈwɔːrm ˌɪnˈsaɪd. ˈiːvən ðə ˈbʌsɪz ˈhæv ˈhiːtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Did you see the snowstorm on the news? It looked terrible.
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈsiː ðə ˈsnoʊstɔːrm ɑːn ðə ˈnuːz? ɪt ˈlʊkt ˈtɛrəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was in it! There was so much snow that the university canceled classes.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ɪn ɪt! ðɛr wʌz soʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈsnoʊ ðæt ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈkænsəld ˈklæsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? When I was at school in my hometown, we went to school even in snowstorms!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? wɛn aɪ wʌz ət ˈskuːl ɪn maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn, wiː ˈwɛnt tə ˈskuːl ˈiːvən ɪn ˈsnoʊstɔːrmz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, I'm staying under my blanket until I go home!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪm ˈsteɪɪŋ ˈʌndər maɪ ˈblæŋkɪt ənˈtɪl aɪ ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm!
